The '''Kiana''' was a secret order on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]], dedicated to fighting against the secret cults who practiced blood sacrifices and worshipped the [[tasar crystal]]s. The [[Tasari]] [[Valjak]] was a member of the Kiana during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="J15" />
